key_reasoning.reason: Four components: shared rule in utils/model-value.ts, the AgentCLI launcher check, the new ModelValueGuardPlugin, and its registration in plugins/index.ts plus the CLAUDE_PATH_CLIENTS list in proxy-clients.ts. The shared util is consumed from two layers.

The new proxy plugin sits on every Claude-path request. It parses the body, answers 400 in the Anthropic error envelope and must not leak the value. The closest pattern is DesktopModelsPlugin (early handleRequest short-circuit), which does not cover input validation. The acceptance criteria enumerate edge cases (not text, empty, too long, whitespace, control, BOM, zero-width) and no existing shared-table test template covered them, so Technical Risk is bumped from M to L.

13 files changed (11-15 maps to XL). Most are new test files, a shared JSON case table and docs; production code is 5 files (model-value.ts, model-value-guard.plugin.ts, index.ts, proxy-clients.ts, AgentCLI.ts).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: enumerated edge and error cases with no existing test template (parameterized shared case table created).
